name: Local AI Assistant
description: Ask questions and get synonyms from any OpenAI-compatible server (llama-server, llama-swap, vLLM, LM Studio, Ollama, OpenAI)

preferences.name: AI Question
preferences.description: Ask any question to the configured AI server

preferences.name: Server URL
preferences.description: Any OpenAI-compatible base URL. /v1 is added automatically if missing.

preferences.name: Model
preferences.description: Model id to request. On llama-swap this is the swap key. Leave blank to let the server pick.

preferences.name: API Key (optional)
preferences.description: Only needed for servers that check it. Local llama-server does not.

preferences.name: Disable model thinking
preferences.description: Send enable_thinking=false so reasoning models (Qwen3 etc.) answer instead of returning an empty string.

preferences.name: Timeout (seconds)
preferences.description: Cold model loads on llama-swap can take a minute. Default 120.

preferences.name: Max Results
preferences.description: Maximum number of items to display
